unowned.note: Deliberately chargeable to no system: prose, audit records, and the repo-wide manifests that change for every system's reasons and none of their own. Everything else must be owned, and audit-status fails when a tracked file is neither.

systems.name: DSL load path
systems.note: The 2026-07-30 pass verified the previous reconciliation's R1, R2 (both halves), R7 and R8 closed, and found H1: list.parseBlock is the one fresh-cursor sub-parse 4f1b648 missed, so a block-form list line silently drops a typo — reproduced on the shipped file, where one letter turns the front-door gate into an unconditional edge. Its three mediums are all one theme, that a removal removing nothing says nothing, plus hydrate breaking the referenceSites single-traversal invariant. The earlier baseline is dsl-modules-2026-07-29-reconciled.md, which reconciles two independent passes that each found a HIGH the other missed; read it for the history rather than the source docs. Owns content/, the shipped DSL this path exists to load; the contribution system's files under src/content are owned by both, which is double coverage rather than a gap — five commits in the 2026-07-30 window are charged to both counters and were not re-audited here.

systems.name: Runtime
systems.note: The 2026-07-30 pass verified the integer conversion's core claim — 875 split points across a sign-changing rate all agree with the one-shot resolve, and every write into state.resources/time/progress is closed under the integer scale — and found H1: checkSave gives the three object-shaped save fields (activeAction, player, activeBuffs) no check past isObject, so a body whose ids are all real but whose cadences is absent crashes loadSave with a raw TypeError from inside the validator that exists to prevent it. Its mediums are all about what the window did not measure: the shipped # test regressions pass with every pool off by 1000x (mutation-verified, because the one save fixture pins health at 0, the value a scale change fixes), ability: 2.5 deals 2.5 down the healthless path and 2.0 down the target: path, and rng is the one GameState number left as isNumber so a fractional cursor collapses onto a fixed stream. Pass-1 L4 and L6 stay open and BLOCKED on the action.health/target: unification; M2 is fresh measured evidence for it. Pass-2 L1 and pass-1 L2 closed 2026-07-29. Counter restarts at the restructure; pre-move commits are not attributable per layer.

systems.name: Contribution system
systems.note: Was recorded as unbuilt with no paths while its code demonstrably existed, so its commits were charged to Testing Procedure's broad scripts coverage. Given real paths 2026-07-29, then baselined by two independent audits (contribution-system-2026-07-29.md and -independent.md) reconciled in the doc above — read that one; it carries the agreement ranking and the reproductions. Neither source doc is sufficient alone: the first pass certified the issue-body extraction as closed and the second reproduced a HIGH in it, while the second missed the raw-regex namespace rewrite the first found. The seven decisions the reconciliation surfaced are settled in backlog.md under a three-tier label model (mod-pending / mod-approved / mod-auto-enabled), which supersedes the flat approved-mod label the audits were written against; R1 and R4 are fixed against it and the manifest is now v2. The editor and the validation/merge engine are still unbuilt.

systems.name: User interface
systems.note: src/ui does not exist; the 2026-07-28 audit covers teardown residue only, and its coverage is structurally limited until the GUI rebuild.

systems.name: Testing procedure
systems.note: The 2026-07-30 pass verified the 2026-07-28 closures and found H1: /test runs a # test against the LIVE session state, so it rewinds the player and makes /create-valid-test emit a test that fails on its own first replay — reproduced end to end. Its mediums are one theme, gates claiming more than they check: an unresolvable lastAudit aborts the whole ledger before any verdict, the doc gate or the partition check, and 7676c09's hook reads that crash as silence (M1); layer-check never reads any file directly under src/, in either direction (M2); /create-test is the one authoring command that bypasses the /dsl machinery that would validate and persist it (M3). Owns .claude/hooks (2026-07-28 M5). Its scripts coverage names the files it implements, except that scripts/lib is declared whole and so double-charges the contribution system's modportalCache.ts — L4, open. Eleven of this window's sixteen commits reached it only through scripts/play-cli.ts, which is a downstream consumer of every layer beneath it; the coverage is still earned, since nobody else audits that file and H1 and M3 are both in it. runTest and # test parsing live under src/ and are covered by the DSL load path and Runtime as well.

systems.name: Build & deployment
systems.note: H2 open: a tag push would publish the placeholder build. M1 fixed: package.json and tsconfig.json are no longer members, because every commit that had ever spent this budget did so through them while the pipeline files themselves never changed.
